title: Jets find new QBs coach in Bill Musgrave — without clarity of who he’ll lead

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets find new QBs coach in Bill Musgrave — without clarity of who he’ll lead
sources.description: Musgrave, a well-traveled assistant coach with six stints as an NFL offensive coordinator, was hired Tuesday as quarterbacks coach under head coach Aaron Glenn and offensive coordinator Frank Reich.
